    About Antigravity-i18n-Pro

    A single-file tool that localizes the Antigravity desktop interface, with a focus on Traditional Chinese for Taiwan. Pure Go, no Node runtime.

    • Your own languages export a template, translate it and apply it as a language file; it is checked before anything is written.
    • Byte-exact restore a clean app.asar is kept before the first patch, and restoring brings back the official file byte for byte.
    • Verified and rolled back offsets and integrity are recalculated, and any failing step puts everything back.

    Based on antigravity-i18n by wade19990814-hue.

    A community-maintained, unofficial tool, not affiliated with Antigravity.

    Switch language?

    Antigravity has to be closed first.
